text.p: These are the leading stories in the Malawi press on Thursday.
Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- The government lost revenue totalling 320,589 million kwacha ($21.37 million) during the fiscal year ending March 1995, a Parliamentary Public Accounts Committee told the National Assembly.

- Members of the National Assembly unanimously welcomed a bill authorising government to borrow 19 million kwacha (8,400 Swedish Krona) for the country's Electricity Supply Commission for the rehabilitation of the main power supply system.
- The ruling United Democratic Front (UDF) is expected to launch a multi-million kwacha propoganda project ahead of general elections in 1999.
